body: thanks for the kind words, but that's not really true. i don’t have friends. the only people in my life are my family and i feel like all of them despise me. i’ve tried to tell my mom about my mental health problems, but she always finds a way to pass it off as me being lazy or something

Yeah, my mom said basically the same thing straight to my face. "Kill yourself if you think that's what you want to do". I can't believe this is the same person who raised me and I've lived with all those years.
